name: @crossberryweb/mozhi
description: Mozhi programming language — official npm distribution. Fast, beginner-friendly scripting language with a native HTTP server, template engine, JSON stack, sandboxed filesystem and SQLite. Bundles the official static Linux x86_64/arm64 binaries and installs the `mozhi` command.
author: crossberry-in <crossberryweb@gmail.com> (https://github.com/crossberry-in)
